olga (acct): Customer Zenith is asking if we can run a 3-week air-gapped POC in their datacenter. Requirements: signed offline bundle, ability to push monthly security micro-patches, quarterly feature upgrades, HSM verification, and an auditable upgrade trail. Any immediate blockers?
ben (sales-eng): Tech stack looks fine: RHEL 8.6 nodes, internal registry, no outbound. Biggest ops question is how they want to receive bundles: SFTP, removable media, or internal object storage.
mira (solutions): We support SFTP and internal S3 pulls. For strictly offline sites we ship signed tarballs + manifest. Micro-patches are produced as delta archives to keep transfer small. For <2h maintenance windows we recommend pre-staging model blobs.
sam (security): Requirements: SBOM, signed manifest verifiable with their KMS public key, optional FIPS libs. If they require us to sign, we need a legal key-escrow agreement. Also need to settle log retention for upgrade audit (suggest 1 year default).
olga (acct): Pricing question: does airgap work change recurring fees?
ben (sales-eng): No change to license. Recommend a one-time engineering packaging & onboarding fee (estimate 3 engineer-days) for the POC and optional ongoing support add-on for automated delta generation.
mira (solutions): Rollback is straightforward: nodes keep previous manifest and image checksums; upgrade tool can switch manifests atomically. We can demo apply/rollback in the POC. Snippet to show: 
```
rdxctl bundle apply /tmp/zenith-micro-2026-04-02.tar.gz --manifest /tmp/manifest.yml
rdxctl bundle rollback --to-manifest manifest-2026-03-01.yml
```
deploy-bot: release rb-20260402-airgap-demo created (id: rb-20260402-13) :package:
sam (security): I'll produce a short checklist for KMS/HSM flows and SBOM expectations. Also will note certificate rotation cadence suggestions.
olga (acct): Action items: 1) Ask Zenith for preferred transfer method and maintenance window length. 2) Ben to produce SOW line for packaging fee. 3) Mira to prepare demo & ops runbook. 4) Sam to share security checklist.
note: olga will schedule technical walkthrough once we have transfer preference.
